Current-main correction / sequential assessment 2026-09-12:
This remains P1 core scientific correctness. The implementation premise in the historical body below is not true on current main: TauEstimator exposes only DL, weighted GroupEngine returns Normal-reference statistics, and GroupModel has no mixedEffects constructor. The cited group-repair document and tools/group-repair are absent.

Located recovery candidate: ab7ad147a23280e29abfe62a7acea27c5559d299 (not an ancestor of HEAD). Its GroupWeighting includes PM and explicit Normal/mKH; its repair report covers first-level identity/SE alignment, contrast construction, unit-scaled rank/weighted solving, typed partial-failure availability and allocation, not just new estimators. The commit is a 157-file bundle, so it is a source/evidence candidate requiring scoped review, not an instruction to cherry-pick it wholesale or a claim it is qualified against current dependencies.

Required first phase before further method admission:
- Inventory current group behavior against the candidate's specific repairs and independent oracle fixtures; preserve current estimate-set and provider ownership boundaries.
- Recover or reimplement the necessary coherent numerical/identity/failure contracts with current Gale APIs; review scientific effects rather than taking a branch globally.
- Requalify JVM and JS public group and first-level bridge behavior, unit/weight conditioning, invalid and partially unavailable samples, and allocation/CPU evidence. Record exact adopted source and consumer pins.
- Only then continue the original held-out inference-admission programme below. Preserve all historical adverse calibration results; PM/mKH formula parity does not justify a universal default, particularly with estimated SEs.

No recovery, numerical qualification, new default or consumer adoption is completed by this assessment. Further REML/robust/multicontrast expansion remains separately deferred in bd-01KX2CQZGWBQ3KKX7BWE28X3T2.
